question: Does a current official UP catalog or library service provide a legitimate route to consult the 2005 Pampanga River fish thesis?

source.citation: Angeles, Sheryll P. (2005). Assessment of the fish population in Pampanga River, Central Luzon, Philippines using the index of biotic integrity. M.S. thesis, University of the Philippines Diliman.

nationalLibraryCatalog.physicalHolding: National Library of the Philippines, Filipiniana General Book Theses, call no. Thesis 597 An43a 2005.

upDilimanCatalog.holding: UP Diliman University Archives, LG 995 2005 E8 A54, room-use-only; item code UARD-11046T.

iesmThesisList.catalogCaveat: The IESM thesis list says it is incomplete and directs readers to contact the IESM Library for authoritative and complete records.

onlineRoutes.result: Previously checked on 2026-10-24; HTTP 404 HTML response, not a thesis PDF.
A second cited filename variant was checked on 2026-11-20; the UP server returned HTTP 404.

possibleLibraryRoute.institution: IESM Library, University of the Philippines Diliman
possibleLibraryRoute.limitations: The services page does not confirm that this thesis can be supplied remotely, reproduced, or consulted by an independent non-UP researcher. Eligibility and item-specific access must be confirmed by the library. The separate UP Diliman library policy says theses and dissertations are room-use-only; its application to the IESM/CS Library holdings was not independently confirmed.

externalContact.reason: No library inquiry or access request was sent during this review.

interpretationAndRights.evidenceLimit: The catalogs identify holdings and access status only. No thesis pages, species tables, station-level results, dates, vouchers, or coordinates were obtained or reviewed.
interpretationAndRights.reuse: No item-specific thesis reuse or reproduction terms were verified. A library listing or room-use access is not permission to reproduce or republish thesis content.
interpretationAndRights.decision: This follow-up improves the access lead only. Keep the thesis research-only; do not infer fish taxa, site assignments, current presence, catchability, geometry, or public-app content from the catalogs or aggregate secondary summary.

nextAction: If pursuing this historical source, ask the IESM Library whether an independent researcher may consult the listed copy or use its Document Delivery Service for this thesis, and what reproduction permissions apply. No access request has been made. If access is unavailable, continue with independently accessible, site-resolved fish surveys and museum/GBIF evidence; do not treat this inaccessible thesis as a blocker to other source work.

sources.supports: National Library catalog title, author, control number, physical location and no-digital-copy statement.
UP Diliman catalog record, University Archives location, call number, room-use-only note and no-digital-copy statement.
IESM thesis list names the 2005 thesis and CS Library/IESM Library holdings, and states the list is incomplete.
IESM Library’s listed services, public email, physical location and hours; does not confirm delivery eligibility for this thesis.
UP Diliman Main Library’s general rule that theses and dissertations are room-use-only; application to the IESM/CS Library holdings remains unconfirmed.
A secondary reference containing the alternate IESM PDF filename variant checked here; the link itself returned HTTP 404.
